 Order

This petition has been filed seeking transfer of entire trial in S.T.C.No.352 of 2022 from the file of the District Munsif Cum Judicial Magistrate at Vanur, Villupuram District to the file of any competent court in https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and perused the materials available on record.
3.

The petitioners are accused in the complaint lodged by the first respondent for the offences punishable Sections 147, 294(b), 420 and 34 of IPC and Section 4 of Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act.

entities.text: Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners are arrayed as A1 and A2 and the respondents 2 to 5 are other accused persons.

The only apprehension of the petitioners is that already the petitioners Harikrishnan vs Abhirami on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89144117/
1 approached the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Villupuram in CMP.No.7667 of 2024 in STC.No.352 of 2022 seeking transfer of the case.

However, it was dismissed on the ground that the petitioners ought to have approached this Court under Section 407 of Cr.P.C.
4.
In view of the above, there is absolutely no ground to transfer the entire trial that too on the request made by the accused.
The petitioners cannot decide the Trial Court for their whims and fancies.
The Trial Court is directed to complete the trial in STC.No.352 of 2022 within a period of six months from https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
( Uploaded on: 06/05/2025 12:00:45 pm ) the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, this Criminal Original petition is dismissed.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous petition is closed.
